description: This file defines the EmailProcessor entity class, which maps to the 'ohrm_email_processor' database table. It includes properties for id, email, and className, along with their respective getter and setter methods, serving as a data model for email processing configurations within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmailProcessor
classes.description: Entity class representing email processing configurations, including identifiers and associated email references.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the email processor.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the email processor.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Associates an Email entity with this processor.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Gets the class name for processing logic, nullable.

methods.name: setClassName
methods.description: Sets the class name for processing logic, nullable.
